# Deep Katbamna — Data Engineer Portfolio

> Professional portfolio of Deep Katbamna, a Data Engineer specializing in scalable data pipelines, cloud data platforms (AWS, Snowflake), DBT transformations, and modern data architecture.

Deep Katbamna is a Data Engineer with 4+ years of experience building enterprise data infrastructure. The site showcases experience, projects, technical skills, and writing on data engineering topics including Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, and AWS Glue.
